title: Bound for the sum of parity layer sizes
statement: Let $r,h$ be natural numbers with $r\ge1$ and $h>0$, and define the size of layer $k$ to be $r^k2^r$. The sum of these sizes for $0\le k<h$ is at most $h r^{h-1}2^r$.
